description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_DisableResources' that extends a URI filter class within the HTMLPurifier library. The class appears to implement a filter that disables resource loading based on the context, specifically when embedded resources are involved.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_DisableResources
classes.description: A URI filter class that disables resource access based on the embedding context.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Determines whether a given URI should be filtered out based on the context's 'EmbeddedURI' setting.
